name: Market breadth exhaustion reversal
hypothesis: Trade the opposite direction only after price rejection and breadth deterioration, using an eligible index instrument.
spec: Setup: An extreme breadth burst may reverse after follow-through fails. Entry: Trade the opposite direction only after price rejection and breadth deterioration, using an eligible index instrument. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on renewed extreme participation or a registered mean/time target. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs point-in-time constituent breadth or auction imbalance data (not free)
